mapper.sql: id, bill_no, owner_id, owner_name, house_id, house_no, parking_id, parking_no, standard_id, fee_type, fee_name, period, amount, paid_amount, pay_status, due_date, pay_time, pay_method, generate_time, remark

where.if: AND (bill_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR owner_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR house_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR parking_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fee_bill (bill_no, owner_id, owner_name, house_id, house_no, parking_id, parking_no, standard_id, fee_type, fee_name, period, amount, paid_amount, pay_status, due_date, pay_time, pay_method, generate_time, remark) VALUES (#{billNo}, #{ownerId}, #{ownerName}, #{houseId}, #{houseNo}, #{parkingId}, #{parkingNo}, #{standardId}, #{feeType}, #{feeName}, #{period}, IFNULL(#{amount}, 0), IFNULL(#{paidAmount}, 0), IFNULL(#{payStatus}, 'UNPAID'), #{dueDate}, #{payTime}, #{payMethod}, NOW(), #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT pay_status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount, IFNULL(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS paidAmount FROM fee_bill GROUP BY pay_status
SELECT fee_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount, IFNULL(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS paidAmount FROM fee_bill GROUP BY fee_type
SELECT period AS name, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount, IFNULL(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS paidAmount, COUNT(*) AS value FROM fee_bill GROUP BY period ORDER BY period ASC
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount - paid_amount), 0) FROM fee_bill WHERE pay_status IN ('UNPAID', 'OVERDUE', 'PARTIAL')
